verdict.rationale: Claude's Cowork feature lets users describe an outcome and step away while Claude executes multi-step tasks on their behalf. That work can run on demand or on a recurring schedule, and Claude can use a built-in browser and computer use to act. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of Cowork task delegation (community evidence covers only coding use).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: With Cowork, you can describe an outcome, step away, and come back to finished work—formatted documents, organized files, synthesized research, and more.
Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.
Scheduled tasks allow you to delegate work to Claude Cowork by creating tasks that run automatically on a recurring basis, or on demand.
Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms while you watch, with no need to switch windows.
